A '''wonat''' was a kind of creature that moved silently due to its [[Hair/Legends|furred]] toe-pads.<ref name="Snare" /> Around [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> while sneaking in the [[Liberator (Liberator-class)|''Trader's Luck'']] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] moved as silently as a wonat.<ref name="Snare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The wonat was first mentioned in ''[[The Paradise Snare]]'', a [[1997]] novel written by [[A. C. Crispin]] as the first book in [[The Han Solo Trilogy (hardcover)|''The Han Solo Trilogy'']].<ref name="Snare" />
